title: Fixing a separated cream sauce
text: Cream sauce separating or breaking: remove from heat immediately. Whisk in a spoonful of cold cream or a splash of cold water. Add a little at a time while whisking until it emulsifies. Avoid boiling cream sauces; keep to a gentle simmer.

title: Substituting butter
text: Out of butter: use olive oil or neutral oil at 3/4 the amount for sauteing. For baking use equal amount of margarine, or 3/4 amount oil, or half amount unsweetened applesauce. Coconut oil works one to one.

title: Substituting buttermilk
text: Out of buttermilk: stir 1 tablespoon lemon juice or white vinegar into 1 cup milk and rest 5 to 10 minutes until slightly curdled. Plain yogurt thinned with milk also works.

title: Cooking rice
text: White rice: rinse, use 1 cup rice to 1.5 to 2 cups water, bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low 15 minutes, then rest 5 minutes off heat. Do not lift the lid.

title: Egg doneness times
text: Soft boiled eggs 6 minutes, jammy 7 minutes, hard boiled 10 to 12 minutes in boiling water, then cool in ice water. Fried eggs 2 to 3 minutes over medium heat.

title: Resting cooked meat
text: Rest steak and chicken 5 to 10 minutes after cooking so juices redistribute. Chicken is safe at 74 C (165 F) internal temperature. Steak medium rare is about 54 to 57 C.

title: Cooking pasta
text: Use plenty of salted boiling water, stir in the first minute to stop sticking, cook to al dente per packet time minus one minute, and reserve a cup of pasta water to loosen sauces.

title: Substituting eggs
text: Out of eggs in baking: 1 tablespoon ground flax mixed with 3 tablespoons water per egg, or 1/4 cup applesauce per egg, or 1/4 cup mashed banana. Not suitable for meringues.

title: Substituting soy sauce
text: Out of soy sauce or soy allergy: coconut aminos 1 to 1, or a mix of salt, water and a little vinegar. Worcestershire sauce works but contains fish.
